name: Industrial / Braun
tagline: Less, but better. One orange switch per screen.
description: A system that behaves like a well made appliance. Warm greys, a strict modular grid, rounded-square keys and round dials, tiny monospaced labels under every control, and a single signal orange reserved for the one thing that matters on each screen.

palette.role: the one signal element per screen

do: Align everything to an 8px grid and group controls into panels like a device face
Put a tiny Azeret Mono label in lowercase under or beside every control and readout
Use rounded-square keys (8px radius) and true circles for dials, knobs and LEDs
Reserve the orange accent for exactly one element per screen: the primary action or the active state
Show state with small LED dots and readouts, not with colored backgrounds
dont: Do not use more than one orange element on a screen
Do not use drop shadows; panels read as recessed or raised through tone and a single inset line
Do not use decorative icons; draw only functional symbols
Do not use bold weights above 700 or condensed type
Do not round corners beyond 8px except for circles

components.name: Button
components.notes: Rounded-square keys on the panel tone with a 1px inset bottom line. Primary is the orange key; secondary is panel; ghost is a text control with a mono label. Pressed state darkens the key and removes the inset line.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Recessed field on panel tone with an ink control edge, mono label above, unit suffix on the right. Error shows an orange-free danger message in ink with a small square marker.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Recessed field with a small triangle marker, styled like a detent switch label.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square checkbox with a solid ink check. Switch is a rounded-square slide switch with an LED dot that lights when on.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Small mono labels with an LED dot: on, standby, offline, and one accent badge for the single current item.

components.name: Card
components.notes: A device module: readout in large numerals, unit in mono, a small dial, and a status LED.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Wordmark left, mono section labels, a single orange action. Mobile menu is a details disclosure laid out as a key grid.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: A panel that slides up with a seam line on top, mono title label, two keys; the confirm key is the only orange.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Schedule table with mono times, room names, target values and LED status, ruled by seams.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Device face: a 2x2 dial tile, readout tiles, a key grid tile, and a level meter drawn with segments.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: A drawn outline of a module slot, one line explaining what to plug in, one key action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: A thin panel strip with an LED dot and a mono timestamp.
